summary: Iteration 13: Verified real Leaflet.js interactive map in Mausam. Backend /api/weather now returns numeric wind_direction on current + all 24 hourly rows for Rajahmundry, Hyderabad and Mumbai. Frontend map renders react-leaflet MapContainer with real OSM tiles (12 tiles loaded), CSS filter applied to .leaflet-tile-pane for storm-glass dark theme (invert(1) hue-rotate(190deg) saturate(0.85) brightness(0.9) contrast(0.95)), a real Leaflet marker with popup, and CircleMarker/wind-arrow overlays that update on layer switch. AQI + Satellite layer buttons are absent — only 3 buttons (Temperature/Rainfall/Wind). data-active-layer syncs correctly on the map-canvas. Location sync verified: switching to Hyderabad (via saved-place card) and Mumbai (via location search) updates map-pin-label, map-value-chip and re-loads tiles. Leaflet zoom control present. No console errors. Mobile 390x844 has no horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: react-leaflet's MapContainer does not forward arbitrary HTML attributes like data-testid to the DOM container. Fixed by using the whenReady callback to setAttribute('data-testid','leaflet-map') on the container element (see /app/frontend/src/App.js WeatherMap). Consider making this an official pattern for any future map testability hooks.

WeatherMap component + CircleMarker layer swap logic looks clean; overlays correctly conditional on `layer`. Wind arrow uses a rotated SVG divIcon — nicely aligned with wind_direction now that the backend supplies it.
MapController fly-to on selectedPlace change works and re-centers the map (verified for Hyderabad + Mumbai). No stale label after switching.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/App.js (WeatherMap: added whenReady handler to set data-testid on Leaflet container so automation can locate the map DOM element)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real Leaflet map integration is stable. Key selectors verified: [data-testid=leaflet-map], [data-testid=map-pin-label], [data-testid=map-value-chip], [data-testid=map-layer-tabs], [data-testid=map-layer-temperature|rainfall|wind], [data-testid=map-canvas-<layer>] (also carries data-active-layer). Location switch is via saved-place-<name> cards or [data-testid=location-selector] modal (uses location-search-input + location-result-<slug>). AQI/Satellite buttons intentionally absent. Backend wind_direction present at current.wind_direction and hourly[i].wind_direction. OSM tiles + CSS filter is the dark-theme strategy (no API key needed).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only a minor testability gap (MapContainer not forwarding data-testid) which was fixed inline with whenReady handler so the leaflet-map testid selector now resolves.
